posts.title: Say which AI wrote it
posts.description: AI tools now write a growing part of the code that reaches Open Source projects, including mine. I don’t think the interesting question is whether a project should accept it: that is each project’s choice. Where it is accepted, I would like it to be done openly. posts.title: Keeping the Word "I": Moving Back to SourceHut
posts.description: Some of my projects are more than fifteen years old. I have been writing software for most of my life and I still enjoy it as much as the first day. It is one of the few things I know how to build. I play the piano, but apart from that I am not good with my hands. I don’t make furniture, I don’t fix engines. What I make is software. posts.title: Keeping My XSLT-Styled Feed Alive After Chrome Drops It
posts.description: Last year I gave my RSS feed a fresh coat of XSLT , so that a curious visitor opening https://www.cedricbonhomme.org/blog/index.xml in a browser would see a friendly little landing page instead of angle-bracket soup.
